questions.label: Are extreme temperatures frequently experienced in the settlement?
questions.hint: During the year (across seasons), is temperature higher/lower than usual?

questions.label: Are the temperature intensities increasing?

questions.label: Are there effects on community members being attributed to extreme temperature?
questions.hint: How often do you experience heat-related effects e.g. heat stress, heat strokes?
